layman_headline: Both open trades are in the green — sit tight and let winners run.
layman_explanation: Our Solana position is up about 2% and Uniswap is up 5.5%, both moving toward their profit targets. The broader market is calm with Bitcoin flat and Fear & Greed cooling from 69 to 62. The swing trade candidates on the watchlist today are weak — stablecoins, overbought tokens, or coins that have already run hard. Monero surged 25% this week and 10% today, which is exciting but too hot to chase right now.
layman_action: Do nothing new today. Keep holding SOL and UNI with their existing stop-losses. If Monero pulls back to ~$480, it could become an attractive entry. Watch UNI closely — it's more than halfway to its $5.65 target.
expert_reasoning: The swing candidate pool this cycle is unusually poor. PUMP has RSI 75 with a -12.9% weekly decline — a bearish divergence suggesting further downside. MON has zero technical indicators available. SOL and UNI are already held. XMR's 25% weekly rally is the standout move, but entering after a +10% daily candle violates swing discipline. BTC dominance at 59.7% continues to pressure alts, and Fear & Greed trending down from 69 to 62 suggests waning risk appetite. The best play is patience — hold existing winners and wait for a cleaner setup.
